TEXT ON A PATHSIX MORE STUDIES IN MOTION
GLOBE · CODEX · CLAUDE · BOOK · CARD · CLOTH
FIG 06

Globe

Land drawn as type along the latitude lines. Drag, scroll and click to pin.

FIG 07

Codex

The mark’s outline sampled as one path, with a sentence running its full length.

FIG 08

Claude Code

Two marks sharing a cloud of glyphs, paired so the change reads as a turn.

FIG 09

Book

The turning leaf is a curved surface, not a door. Drag through five spreads.

FIG 10

Card

Every glyph placed in card space, pushed through the same perspective divide.

FIG 11

Cloth

A verlet sheet of letters that shear with the weave. Grab it and pull.
